data.text: How about we redistribute this month’s catch while keeping the total at 50 tons? I’ll take 5 tons rather than 10, and I propose John take 15, with Kate, Jack, and Emma taking 10 each. That would give John $15,000 and me $5,000, while leaving 50 tons to reproduce back to 100. My own catch this month will be 5 tons; everyone else’s shares are proposals, not assumed agreements. For future months, we could discuss rotating who takes the smaller and larger shares. John, would you be willing to take 15 under this plan? Kate, Jack, and Emma, would 10 each work for you?
